methods.description: Test all matching folds, without counting halves as lines.
Count matching positions during one full turn, including the full turn.
Distinguish diagonal folds from midpoint fold lines.
Use known properties and recognise when two types fit.
Use a general parallelogram to disprove a link between fold and turn symmetry.
